translation: <ins>Jie Xue Ointment (截血膏)</ins> Treats the various conditions of falls, blows, and chopping; it can transform blood and break stasis, reduce swelling and stop pain. Trichosanthes root (天花粉, three liang), sliced turmeric (片子薑黃), red peony (赤芍藥), angelica dahurica (白芷, each one liang). Grind the above together into a fine powder, mix evenly with tea, and apply around the four sides of the wound. If the head or face is injured and the blood does not stop, urgently use this medicine mixed and applied around the neck.
